title: Cuba says 4 killed, 6 injured aboard Florida speedboat after shootout
text: Cuba says 4 killed, 6 injured aboard Florida speedboat after shootoutCuban officials claim the speedboat violated territorial waters by approaching within one nautical mile of the El Pino Channel.
